title: We built a matching
platform with Claude
in one month
slides.subtitle: A tool that matches home sellers to the right estate agent, plus a CRM and a brand kit. About £90 a month in tools to run.

slides.label: The idea
slides.detail: Sellers pick an agent on fees and brochures. We wanted to match them on what they need and the personality they want, so the sale feels right.
slides.start: Write down who your tool is for and what a good result looks like, in two sentences.

slides.label: The usual route
slides.detail: In our estimate, a first version built the traditional way would have cost tens of thousands of pounds and taken several months. That is our judgement, not a published figure.
slides.start: Ask yourself what your idea would cost if you only built the smallest working slice.

slides.label: Piece 1: the matching tool
slides.detail: A seller answers questions about their sale and the personality they want in an agent. The tool matches them to the agent who fits best.
slides.start: Start with the one feature people would use on day one.

slides.label: Piece 2: a CRM for agents
slides.detail: Every lead is tracked in one back end, so agents see where each enquiry came from and what happens next.
slides.start: Give every lead one home. Retire the spreadsheets and inbox folders.

slides.label: Piece 3: a brand kit
slides.detail: Colours, type and tone settled once, so marketing material and social posts come out consistent and good-looking every time.
slides.start: Pick two colours, two fonts and a tone of voice. Write them down.

slides.label: The tools and the cost
slides.detail: Claude, Postgres, Vercel, Apify and Firecrawl. About £500 in tools to build and about £90 a month to run. Tool costs only, not a fee and not our time.
slides.start: List the tools your idea would need. Price them per month, not per project.

slides.label: The early signal
slides.detail: Strong feedback from the agents involved, and several leads so far, most of which went on to instruct. A small sample, so we draw no big conclusions.
slides.start: Show your first version to three real users this week and ask what is missing.

title: One month.
Real leads.
slides.body: Our own venture, built for ourselves and a partner. Your costs and results will differ.
slides.cta: If this interests you, or you have an idea you want to bring to life, contact us.
